- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18921-18930 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN is empty, the `::warning::` and `continue` are emitted per tracking issue. With many projects, the workflow log receives one duplicate warning per project per tick, drowning out other diagnostics. A persistent credential failure halts all project processing while emitting only soft `::warning::` lines.
  WHY: there is no per-tick de-duplication or escalation. A 6-hour degraded mode produces 720+ warnings, making the persistent condition look like transient noise rather than a credential failure. No alert path (Telegram, GitHub issue label) fires.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18923-18926 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When UNBLOCK_TRUSTED_LOGIN is empty (e.g., expired/unscoped GH_PAT or sustained rate-limit exhaustion), the poller skips every tracking issue with only a `::warning::` in the workflow log. No Telegram alert or `ai:needs-human` label is applied, so a persistent credential failure could silently halt all orchestration across many 5-minute ticks without operator notification beyond the workflow log.
  WHY: An expired PAT would cause `gh api user` to return empty on every tick. The poller would log `::warning::Cannot verify state comment author for tracking issue #N; skipping this tick.` for each tracking issue, every tick, but no CRITICAL Telegram alert or GitHub label surfaces the persistent condition to an operator who is not actively watching workflow logs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
